description: Connect a source to a workspace, or sign a connector in again: returns a link to Foundry for the user to open in their browser, so credentials never pass through the agent. A kind whose sign_in is true (helix_foundry_list_connector_kinds) connects by signing in at its provider: follow the result's sign_in_id with helix_foundry_get_sign_in. Any other kind, or with_key, opens the kind's form, where the user enters its credentials; then helix_foundry_list_connectors lists the new connector.

client_token.description: Up to 64 characters; a retry with the same token returns the sign-in the first call started.

connector_id.description: Sign this connector in again instead of making one: one whose account needs signing in (helix_foundry_list_connectors). It keeps its name and settings.

kind.description: The connector's kind: stripe, workos, posthog, github, linear, calcom, granola, slack, notion, google, databuddy, attio, postgres, mysql, s3 or events (an API source).

name.description: A new connector's name when it signs in; the kind's display name when empty. Not with connector_id.

project_id.description: A new PostHog connector's project id when it signs in, a number from its project settings; empty takes the account's one project. Not with connector_id.

repos.description: A new GitHub connector's repositories when it signs in, as owner/name. None reads the repositories of the Helix Foundry GitHub App's installations the user can reach. Not with connector_id.

with_key.description: Open the kind's form to enter a key instead of signing in: for PostHog EU Cloud or a self-hosted PostHog, or when the user asks to use a key.

workspace_id.description: Helix workspace identifier. May be empty when the caller has only one workspace (a service key always does).

name: helix_foundry_connect
title: Connect a source
